__inputs.name: DS_MYSQL
__inputs.label: ioBroker MySQL
__inputs.description: MySQL/MariaDB data source with ioBroker SQL history

panels.description: GPS-Höhe aus location/altitude_m im gewählten Zeitraum. Das Panel verwendet dieselbe Zeitachse wie das Leistungsdiagramm.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.ts DIV 1000 AS time, t.val AS 'Höhe' FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.location.altitude_m') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000 ORDER BY t.ts

panels.title: Höhenprofil

panels.description: Differenz aus grösstem und kleinstem Kilometerstand im gewählten Zeitraum.

targets.rawSql: SELECT GREATEST(MAX(t.val)-MIN(t.val),0) AS value FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.display.odometer_km') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000

panels.title: Gefahrene Strecke

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(t.val) AS value FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.display.speed_kmh') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000

panels.description: Integrierte positive Fahrzeugleistung; Lücken über 30 Sekunden werden ausgeschlossen.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT t.ts,t.val,LEAD(t.ts) OVER (ORDER BY t.ts) AS next_ts FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.bms.vehicle_power_w') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN val>0 AND next_ts-ts BETWEEN 0 AND 30000 THEN val*(next_ts-ts) ELSE 0 END)/3600000000.0,0) AS value FROM p

panels.title: Verbrauch · gemessen

panels.description: Integrierte negative Fahrzeugleistung bei gemeldetem Rekuperationszustand; Lücken über 30 Sekunden werden ausgeschlossen.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT t.ts,t.val,LEAD(t.ts) OVER (ORDER BY t.ts) AS next_ts FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.bms.vehicle_power_w') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN val<0 AND next_ts-ts BETWEEN 0 AND 30000 AND COALESCE((SELECT b.val FROM ts_bool b JOIN datapoints db ON db.id=b.id WHERE db.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.bms.is_regenerating') AND b.ts<=p.ts ORDER BY b.ts DESC LIMIT 1),0)=1 THEN -val*(next_ts-ts) ELSE 0 END)/3600000000.0,0) AS value FROM p

panels.title: Rekuperation · gemessen

panels.description: Integrierte negative Fahrzeugleistung bei gemeldetem Ladezustand; Lücken über 30 Sekunden werden ausgeschlossen.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT t.ts,t.val,LEAD(t.ts) OVER (ORDER BY t.ts) AS next_ts FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.bms.vehicle_power_w') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN val<0 AND next_ts-ts BETWEEN 0 AND 30000 AND (COALESCE((SELECT b.val FROM ts_bool b JOIN datapoints db ON db.id=b.id WHERE db.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.charging.is_charging') AND b.ts<=p.ts ORDER BY b.ts DESC LIMIT 1),0)=1 OR COALESCE((SELECT b.val FROM ts_bool b JOIN datapoints db ON db.id=b.id WHERE db.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.charging.plugged') AND b.ts<=p.ts ORDER BY b.ts DESC LIMIT 1),0)=1 OR COALESCE((SELECT s.val FROM ts_number s JOIN datapoints ds ON ds.id=s.id WHERE ds.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.display.speed_kmh') AND s.ts<=p.ts ORDER BY s.ts DESC LIMIT 1),0)<=1) THEN -val*(next_ts-ts) ELSE 0 END)/3600000000.0,0) AS value FROM p

panels.title: Geladen · gemessen

panels.description: Nettoverbrauch aus Verbrauch minus Rekuperation, bezogen auf die Kilometerstanddifferenz. Erst ab 0,1 km.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT t.ts,t.val,LEAD(t.ts) OVER (ORDER BY t.ts) AS next_ts FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.bms.vehicle_power_w') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000), e AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN next_ts-ts BETWEEN 0 AND 30000 THEN val*(next_ts-ts) ELSE 0 END)/3600000000.0 AS net_kwh FROM p), km AS (SELECT MAX(t.val)-MIN(t.val) AS distance_km FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.display.odometer_km') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000) SELECT CASE WHEN km.distance_km>=0.1 THEN e.net_kwh*100.0/km.distance_km ELSE NULL END AS value FROM e CROSS JOIN km

panels.title: Nettoverbrauch

panels.description: Kilometerstand relativ zum ersten Messwert des gewählten Zeitraums.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.ts DIV 1000 AS time, t.val-MIN(t.val) OVER () AS 'Strecke' FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.display.odometer_km') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000 ORDER BY t.ts

panels.title: Gefahrene Strecke im Zeitraum

panels.description: Verbrauch wird positiv, Rekuperation und Laden werden negativ dargestellt; Geschwindigkeit liegt auf der rechten Achse. Laden verwendet is_charging, plugged oder Stillstand als Fallback.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.ts DIV 1000 AS time, CASE WHEN t.val>0 THEN t.val/1000.0 END AS 'Verbrauch' FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.bms.vehicle_power_w') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000 ORDER BY t.ts

SELECT t.ts DIV 1000 AS time, CASE WHEN t.val<0 AND COALESCE((SELECT b.val FROM ts_bool b JOIN datapoints db ON db.id=b.id WHERE db.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.bms.is_regenerating') AND b.ts<=t.ts ORDER BY b.ts DESC LIMIT 1),0)=1 THEN t.val/1000.0 END AS 'Rekuperation' FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.bms.vehicle_power_w') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000 ORDER BY t.ts

SELECT t.ts DIV 1000 AS time, CASE WHEN t.val<0 AND (COALESCE((SELECT b.val FROM ts_bool b JOIN datapoints db ON db.id=b.id WHERE db.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.charging.is_charging') AND b.ts<=t.ts ORDER BY b.ts DESC LIMIT 1),0)=1 OR COALESCE((SELECT b.val FROM ts_bool b JOIN datapoints db ON db.id=b.id WHERE db.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.charging.plugged') AND b.ts<=t.ts ORDER BY b.ts DESC LIMIT 1),0)=1 OR COALESCE((SELECT s.val FROM ts_number s JOIN datapoints ds ON ds.id=s.id WHERE ds.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.display.speed_kmh') AND s.ts<=t.ts ORDER BY s.ts DESC LIMIT 1),0)<=1) THEN t.val/1000.0 END AS 'Laden' FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.bms.vehicle_power_w') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000 ORDER BY t.ts

SELECT t.ts DIV 1000 AS time, GREATEST(t.val,0) AS 'Geschwindigkeit' FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.display.speed_kmh') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000 ORDER BY t.ts

panels.title: Leistung und Geschwindigkeit

panels.description: Aus Ladeleistung integrierte Tageswerte. Zeitlücken über 30 Sekunden werden nicht ergänzt; daher gemessene Mindestenergie.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT t.ts,t.val,LEAD(t.ts) OVER (ORDER BY t.ts) AS next_ts FROM ts_number t JOIN datapoints d ON d.id=t.id WHERE d.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.bms.vehicle_power_w') AND t.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000), c AS (SELECT p.*,COALESCE((SELECT b.val FROM ts_bool b JOIN datapoints db ON db.id=b.id WHERE db.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.charging.is_charging') AND b.ts<=p.ts ORDER BY b.ts DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS charging,COALESCE((SELECT b.val FROM ts_bool b JOIN datapoints db ON db.id=b.id WHERE db.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.charging.plugged') AND b.ts<=p.ts ORDER BY b.ts DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS plugged,COALESCE((SELECT s.val FROM ts_number s JOIN datapoints ds ON ds.id=s.id WHERE ds.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.display.speed_kmh') AND s.ts<=p.ts ORDER BY s.ts DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS speed FROM p) SELECT (ts DIV 86400000)*86400 AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN val<0 AND (charging=1 OR plugged=1 OR speed<=1) AND next_ts-ts BETWEEN 0 AND 30000 THEN -val*(next_ts-ts) ELSE 0 END)/3600000000.0 AS 'Geladene Mindestenergie' FROM c GROUP BY ts DIV 86400000 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN val<0 AND (charging=1 OR plugged=1 OR speed<=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Ladeenergie pro UTC-Tag

panels.description: Route aus separat freigegebener GPS-Historie. Pfeile folgen der Zeitreihenfolge. Blau zeigt negative Fahrzeugleistung (während der Fahrt typischerweise Rekuperation); Verbrauch wechselt bei 0/3/10 kW von grün über gelb zu rot. Für eine einzelne Fahrt den Zeitraum eng wählen.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lat.ts DIV 1000 AS time, lat.val AS latitude, (SELECT lon.val FROM ts_number lon JOIN datapoints dl ON dl.id=lon.id WHERE dl.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.location.longitude') AND ABS(lon.ts-lat.ts)<=10000 ORDER BY ABS(lon.ts-lat.ts) LIMIT 1) AS longitude, (SELECT p.val/1000.0 FROM ts_number p JOIN datapoints dp ON dp.id=p.id WHERE dp.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.bms.vehicle_power_w') AND ABS(p.ts-lat.ts)<=10000 ORDER BY ABS(p.ts-lat.ts) LIMIT 1) AS power_kw, (SELECT GREATEST(s.val,0) FROM ts_number s JOIN datapoints ds ON ds.id=s.id WHERE ds.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.display.speed_kmh') AND ABS(s.ts-lat.ts)<=10000 ORDER BY ABS(s.ts-lat.ts) LIMIT 1) AS speed_kmh FROM ts_number lat JOIN datapoints dlat ON dlat.id=lat.id WHERE dlat.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.location.latitude') AND lat.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000 AND lat.val BETWEEN -90 AND 90 HAVING longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180 ORDER BY lat.ts

SELECT lat.ts DIV 1000 AS time, lat.val AS latitude, (SELECT lon.val FROM ts_number lon JOIN datapoints dl ON dl.id=lon.id WHERE dl.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.location.longitude') AND ABS(lon.ts-lat.ts)<=10000 ORDER BY ABS(lon.ts-lat.ts) LIMIT 1) AS longitude, 'https://www.microlino-open-telemetry.ch/images/microlino-outline.svg' AS image_url FROM ts_number lat JOIN datapoints dlat ON dlat.id=lat.id WHERE dlat.name=CONCAT('mqtt.2.mot.', ${vehicle:sqlstring}, '.location.latitude') AND lat.ts BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000 AND lat.val BETWEEN -90 AND 90 HAVING longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180 ORDER BY lat.ts DESC LIMIT 1
